name: Redeemer’s Patience (Combat)
body:
You allow your foes ample opportunities to surrender, striking only when they prove uncooperative and unrepentant.

Prerequisite(s): Diplomacy 5 ranks, base attack bonus +4.

Benefit(s): Whenever an opponent misses you with a melee attack, you can use an immediate action to make a Diplomacy check to demand their surrender, with a DC equal to that of a demoralize attempt against the target. If the check succeeds, the target is shaken for 1 round. If the opponent refuses to surrender and instead attacks you on their next turn, you receive a morale bonus on the attack and weapon damage rolls for your next attack against this opponent equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1). Dealing lethal damage before the opponent’s next turn makes you lose this morale bonus.
